description: Twumvise ingene umwami Hezekiya yavyifashemwo yumvise ko ab'Ashuri bamaze kwigarurira ibisagara vyo mu buraruko bw'I Buyuda bakaba bamaramaje gutera I Yerusalemu . Hezekiya yaciye yitantamurirako impuzu ,yambara amagunira , yinjira mu ngoro y'Uhoraho kuko yarazi ko atabundi buhungiro. Yaciye kandi atuma intumwa kuwavugishwa n'Imana Yesaya kugira amenye ico yokora.
name: Abasinziriye itiro ry'urupfu bari muri Kristo Yesu

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'umushumba w'Uhoraho ariwe muco w'amahanga twisunzwe ivyanditse mu gitabu ca Yesaya 49 .Kuva kera Imana yari yarakunze ihanga rya Isirayeri ikaryita umushumba wayo ariko uko ryagiye rirananirwa n' ukugenda riratemba mu vyagezwe vyayo niko ryagiye rigira ivyago. Iryo hanga ryarananiwe ariko Umwami Yesu wewe ntiyananiwe. Uwo niwe mushuma w'Uhoraho we yaje gucungura abo mw'isi bose.
name: Abatizera ukuri bazogira iherezo ribi

description: Twavuganye ku mburi yo kuri Damasiko na Efurayimu hamwe no ku gihugu kiri hakurya y'inzuzi za Etiyopiya.
name: Abisirayeri basenga basaba imbabazi

description: Twavuganye ku bijanye n'imburi yo kuri Babuloni twongera twibukanya ukuntu Imana izosubiza agateka ab'Isirayeli ikabatororokanya iyo bagiye hose bakagaruka mu gihugu c'isezerano kandi ico gihe Yesu niwe azoba ku ntebe y'inganji acire imanza amahanga yahahaje ubwoko bw'Imana.
name: Agakiza ukwo kameze

description: Twaganiriye ku vy' ububasha bw' Uhoraho, inkomezi zitangwa nawe , ibiteye ubwoba abatubaha Imana hamwe n'ibiremesha abayubaha.
name: Amabwirizwa agenga abakristo

description: Twarumvise ingene umwami Hezekiya yasenze Imana nayo ikamwumva ikishura amasengesho yiwe . Imana yamukuye mu minwe y'ab' Ashuri bari bamugeramiye ,yongera imukiza ingwara yagira imwice imwongera imyaka 15 y'ukubaho .
name: Dukwiye kwitegurira ukuza kwa Yesu Kristo

description: Twabonye intangamarara y'igitabu ca Yesaya.Twabonye ko ico gitabu c'ubuhanuzi bwa Yesaya yavuze ku bihe yabayemwo kandi ko yahanuye no kuri kazoza.Mu vyo yahanuye hari ivyashitse akairiho n'ibindi vyashitse aza yarapfuye.
name: Hezekiya ashimira Imana ko yamukijije

description: Twavuganye ku mburi zo ku mahanga akikije ihanga rya Isirayeli .
name: Ibikorwa biva ku kwizera

description: Twumvise amasengesho y'Ab' Isirayeri basaba ko Imana yokwururuka ikabakura mu marushwa kandi twarumvise n'inyishu bahawe kur'ayo masengesho yabo. Imana yababwiyeko ubugarariji bwabo aribwo bwabakwegeye ivyago kandi ko abakomeza kuyicumurako bazopfa kandi bazoshishikara kuba mu ngorane. Yarababwiye ko itazorandura bose ngo izoziguriza amasigarira y' abantu bake bayubaha kugira ngo ize ibashitseko amasezerano yayo.
name: Ikimenyetso c'ikarabo rimenetse

description: Twabonye ukuntu Imana yahanye ihanga rya Isirayeli , irihanishije irindi hanga ry' Abasiriya kubera Abasiriya nabo nyene batubaha Imana baruhiye guhanwa kuko nabo bari bakwiye igihano . Twarangije tuvuga ko n'ubu Imana itazobura guhana abantu baburigwa ngo bihane ivyaha bakabifata minenegwe ntibihane.
name: Imana igabisha abanyakibi ngo ntibihumurize

description: Twabonye ivy'ubuhanuzi bwavuga ku kuza kwa mbere k'umwami Yesu Kristo hano mw'isi n'ukuntu azogaruka kuganza yicaye ku ntebe ya sekuruza Dawidi. Twabonye ko ubwami bwiwe buzoba ubwami bw'amahoro butagira akarenganyo kandi twabonye ko azohana amahanga yose yateye Imana umugongo uhereye ku bisirayeli ukageza kuri wewe nanje.
name: Imana igaya abakuru kubwo kurebura kwabo

description: Twavuganye ku ntamabara izoba mu minsi yanyuma ariko twabonye ko Umwami Yesu Kristo azogira itsinzi ihambaye ace azana inganji yiwe hano mw'isi.
name: Imana ihanura abantu bayo ngo babe umuco w'amahanga yose.

description: Twize ku buhanuzi bwo mu gitabu c'uwavugishwa n'Imana Yesaya mu gice ca 58 bwo kugabisha abanyakibi. Imana iranka ukwisonzesha kw'abantu bayo iyo babikora buzuye ivyaha mu mitima. Imana iravuga ko ukwisonzesha ishima ar'ukujanye n'ingeso nziza.
name: Imana yabandanije isaba Ab'I Buyuda kuyigarukako

description: Twumviswe ingene Imana yagaye abakuru bo mu Bisirayeri kubwo kureburura kwabo bigatuma ibarekurirako ayandi mahanga akabatabagura. Twarabonye kandi ibintu bimwe bimwe vyerekana itandukaniro hagati y'umugororotsi n'umunyakibi.Imana iraremesha abayigororokera kugira ngo bumve amahoro mu mitima kuko irikumwe nabo.
name: Imana yinginga Isirayeli ngo yihane

description: Twavuganye ku mburi ya Egiputa. Naho umuntu yotera imbere adafise Yesu mu bugingo bwiwe ntaco vyomumarira. Ariko iterambere nyakuri twabonye ko  ari ukubanza kwakira Yesu mu bugingo bwacu.
name: Imana yishura amasengesho y'Ab'Isirayeri

description: Ivyanditswe mu gitabu ca Yesaya biri mu migwi mikuru mikuru itatu:1- Ibice 35 vyambere bivugwamwo ubuhanuzi bwerekeye ivyo guca amateka canke imanza.2- Kuva ku gice ca 36 kugeza ku ca 39 havugwa ivyabaye ku ngoma y'umwami Hezekiya w' I Buyuda.3- Kuva ku gica ca 40 kugeza ku ca 66 havugwamwo ubuhanuzi bwerekeye ivyo gucungugwa. N'ubuhanuzi
name: Imbuto za mpwemu yera

description: Twabonye ibin tu bitandatu Uhoraho Imana yanka yise ibara canke ivyaha birengeje ivyo navyo ni: 1-Ukwikumirako amatongo ,2-ukwirukira ibiboreza, 3-Ukwigira agakura mu kunywa, 4- ubweruzi, 5-ubusambanyi , 6- ukwishira hejuru n'ibindi. Imana ibitubwira kugira tumenye ko bitayihimbara hanyuma duhindure ingeso zacu nimba tugomba kuba abakunzi bayo ngo abe ariyo iturongore.
name: Imibabaro no guca bugufi kw'Umwami Yesu

description: Twavuganye kw'iteka ryaciriweko Samariya na Yerusalemu hamwe no kubijanye n'ubuhanuzi bw'ibihe vyimirije n'ishitswa ry'ubuhanuzi kuri Yerusalemu . Hamwe rero n'ivy'ugushika vy'ubwami bwa Kristo .
name: Ingene Paulo yabereye se n'umuvukanyi Ab' I Tesalonike

description: Twabonye ukuntu Imana yaburiye amahanga hanyuma igahava inabacira urubanza.
name: Ingene Yerusalemu hazosubira gukundwakara

description: Twavuganye kw'ihamwa rihambaye ryo mu bihe vyiteze kuza .Ihamwa rizoba iry'umubabaro ah'abansi b'Imana bazotsindwa bose, Umwami Yesu agaca aza mw'isi kuganza imyaka igihumbi(1000).Kuva mu gice ca 25 kugeza igice ca 27 igitabu ca Yesaya,  harimwo indirimbo yo gutazira, indirimbo y'umunezero utavanze.
name: Inkurikizi z'ubutumwa bwiza

description: Imburi zo kuri Babuloni, Edomu na Arabiya.Twumvise ko abantu baba aho hantu bari Abarabo bakaba bakomoka kuri Ishimayeri, umuhungu w'Aburahamu atari uwisezerano nka Isaka. Abo gushika uno musi ntibacana uwaka n'Abayuda. Guharika sivyiza kuko bizana umuryano mu bana haba igihe wewe ukiriho canke utakiriho, birashobora guteba ariko uburuhiro birashika.
name: Intangamarara y'icete

description: Twashishikaye kubona ubuhanuzi buvuga kuvy'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo uwiswe umunyamibabaro.Twarumvise kandi ivy'ukubambwa kwa Yesu Kristo, bikaba vyanditswe mu gihe Umwami Yesu yarasigaje imyaka amajanindwi (700 ans) ngo avuke.
name: Intangamarara y'igitabu

description: Twaganiriye ingene Abisirayeli bazosubizwa mu gihugu hamwe n'ukuntu Samariya na Yerusaremu hazocirwa kw'iteka.
name: Inyigisho Paulo yahaye ab'I Tesalonike

description: Twabonye ukuntu ab'Isirayeli bakengereye Imana ntibayiha icubahiro cayo nk'Imana yabakoreye ivyiza ntangere. Yarabahanuye kenshi mbere nambere y'intahe kugirango bikebuke ariko ntibahindukira na honyene hanyuma irahava irabahana nk'uko n'uyu musi itazoreka guhana abanse kwihana kandi yama isemerera ibicishije mu bakozi bayo.
name: Ivy' Ihamagagwa rya Kuro

description: Twumvise imburi yo kuri Egiputa no kuri Etiyopiya. Ibi bihugu vyaraburiwe ariko ntivyikebuka hanyuma imburi ibishikako.
name: Ivy'ijuru risha n'isi nsha

description: Twumvise amasengesho y'Ab' Isirayeri basaba ko Imana yokwururuka ikabakura mu marushwa kandi twarumvise n'inyishu bahawe kur'ayo masengesho yabo. Imana yababwiyeko ubugarariji bwabo aribwo bwabakwegeye ivyago kandi ko abakomeza kuyicumurako bazopfa kandi bazoshishikara kuba mu ngorane. Yarababwiye ko itazorandura bose ngo izoziguriza amasigarira y' abantu bake bayubaha kugira ngo ize ibashitseko amasezerano yayo.
name: Ivy'inzu y'umubumvyi

description: Twabonye ko iyo ihanga rishize Imana kure yaryo ntirigire imico myiza,habura ubutegetsi bwiza kandi riba risenyutse cane cane iyo ritigaruye nk'abantu b'I Ninewe dusoma mu gitabu ca Yona bihanye bamaze kwumva imburi Imana ibatumyeko .
name: Ivy'ububasha bw'Uhoraho

description: Twavuganye ukuntu Imana yahaye Yesaya umwana w'umuhungu agira kabiri kugira ngo Imana ihe ikimenyetso ihanga ryayo. Izina ry'uwo muhungu ni Maheri-shalali-hashi-bazi risobanurwa ngo bihutira iminyago, bitera mw'isahu.Hari ico Imana yashatse kubwira abantu bayo ibicishije muri iryo zina kandi abashaka gutahura baratahuye. Twarabonye ko hageze igihe bata Imana barondera inkomezi mu yandi mahanga no mu bindi bigigwamana vy'impwemu mbi. Ivyo vyabakwegeye mu kaga gahambaye kuko Imana itashobora kuvyihanganira.
name: Ivy'ubutumire bw'Imana ku bantu bose

description: Twakomeje kurabira hamwe ingene Ab' Isirayeli birengagije akamo Imana yabateye ngo bihane hanyuma igahava ibahana.
name: Ivy'ugukomvomvogwa kw'I Baburoni

description: Twarabiye hamwe amajambo yo gusozera ikigabane kinini twatanguriye mu gice ca 2 ca Yesaya kivuga ingene Ab' Isirayeli birengagije akamo batewe n' Imana ko kwihana ivyaha vyabo bagahindukirira Imana . Imana ibonye ko bakomantaje imitima yahavuye ibahana. Ibi vyandikiwe twebwe kugirango dukore ibishimwa n' Imana twoye kwikwegera igihano c'Imana.
name: Ivy'Ugukomvomvogwa kw'I Baburoni

description: Twize k'ubuhanuzi bw'ingene Yerusalemu hazosubira gukundwakara nkuko vyanditswe mu gitabo ca Yesaya igice ca 62 . Ico gice kirerekana umunezero uhambaye uzoba ku musi w'Uhoraho kubamwizera bose. Twarihweje kandi ivy'igihano co kuri Edomu n'abagwanya Imana bose.
name: Ivy'umukanda Yeremiya yanyegeje

description: Twaganiriye kuvy'umushumba w'Uhoraho ariwe muco w'amahanga twisunzwe ivyanditse mu gitabu ca Yesaya 49 .Kuva kera Imana yari yarakunze ihanga rya Isirayeri ikaryita umushumba wayo ariko uko ryagiye rirananirwa n' ukugenda riratemba mu vyagezwe vyayo niko ryagiye rigira ivyago. Iryo hanga ryarananiwe ariko Umwami Yesu wewe ntiyananiwe. Uwo niwe mushuma w'Uhoraho we yaje gucungura abo mw'isi bose.
name: Ivyo Imana igomba ku bayizera

description: Twumvise inyigisho nyinshi zijanye n'ingene Imana yanka ibigigwamana. Abasenga ibigigwamana baba bariko bakorana na satani bitayeko ibigwamana ntaco bibarira abantu kuko ntivyumva, ntibibona, ntivyikakaza.
name: Paulo abahanura ngo bakomere mu kwizera

description: Twavuganye ku bwami bw'amahoro bwa Yesu aho azoganza imyaka igihumbi (1000 ans).Ico gihe, intambara n'urupfu bizoba vyatsinzwe kandi vyatsinzwe nawe.Uwariwe wese yihanye , akihana koko ivyaha vyiwe azoba muri ubwo bwami buganzwa na Yesu ubwiwe kandi hano mw'isi.
name: Paulo ahanura ab' I Tesalonike

description: Muri ibi bice vya 43 na 44 vy'igitabu ca Yesaya, twumvise ingene Imana yanka ibigigwamana urunuka.
name: Paulo ahimiriza abakristo b'I Tesalonike kwihanganira amakuba barimwo.

description: Twumvise ubuhanuzi bwo kwiyamiriza ibigigwamana mu gice ca 41.Twarabonye kandi ivy'umushumba w'Uhoraho nk'uko tubisoma mu gice ca 42. Twarangirije ku majambo atangura igice ca 43 aho Imana ibwira abantu bayo ko ibafise ko umugambi mwiza wo kubakiza.
name: Paulo ahumuriza ab'I Tesalonike

description: Tumaze iminsi tuganira kuvy'umushumba w'Uhoraho ariwe Mwami wacu Yesu Kristo no kuvy'ugucungugwa kw'Ab'Isirayeri ko mu gihe kigiye kuza .Imana iravuga ko ibona amarushwa barimwo hirya no hino mw'isi kandi ngo Izobatahukana mu gihugu cabo.Irabaremesha ngo ntibihebure bamenye ko itabahevye.
name: Paulo asaba abakristo b'I Tesalonike ko bamwigana

description: Twabonye Ingene Imana kubw'urukundo rwayo rwinshi itagomba ko umunyavyaha yohanwa ahubwo iramwinginga kugira ngo akizwe ahindukire ave mu nzira y'ivyaha.Nk'uko yagiriye ab'Isilayeli bitirirwa izina ryayo, aho kubahaniraho yabanje kubinginga cane kugira ngo bihane ibaharire kandi n'ubu iracinginga abasubiye inyuma n'abatarihana kugira ngo bayigarukeko ikigongwe cayo kikiriho.
name: Ubuhanuzi bwa Yesaya

description: Twavuganye ku bijanye n'igihano ca Babuloni ku munsi w'Uhoraho. Abo bahanwa kuko baticishije bugufi imbere y'Imana ngo abe ariyo basenga yonyene. Ubwo bugarariji n'abitirigwa izina ryayo aribo b'Isirayeli barabuhaniwe.Ivyo vyerekana ko nubu Imana idashobora kwihanganira ubugarariji bw'abana ba bantu.Nitutihana ngo duhindukire natwebwe uburake bw' Imana ntibuzotuziguriza.
name: Ubwiza bwa Yerusalemu mu gihe c'iherezo

description: Twakomeje kuvugana ku mburi yo kuri Tiro ukuntu hakomvomvowe, abantu baho bakajanwa nk'inyagano kugeza imyaka mirongirindwi (70) ishize.
name: Ugutoranya kw' Imana

description: Twihweje ivy'imbabazi z' Imana n'amahoro bizoba ku bantu bayo .Twarabonye nivy'ugutumirirwa ku buntu.
name: Uhoraho aburira abantu biwe basubiye inyuma

description: Twaraganiriye ivy'amahoro n'imigisha bizoranga ubwami bwa Kristo. Twarumvise iteka rizoterwa Ab'Isirayeri n'ingene bazoshumbushwa umugabane mwiza ariwo munezero w'ibihe bitazoshira.
name: Uko Yeremiya yanswe n'abo mu gisagara ciwe

description: Twavuganye kuvy'integuza y'ivuka rya Yesu Kristo yabaye imyaka myinshi ico gihe kitaranegereza hamwe n'ibitero ab'Ashuri bagiriye ab'I Buyuda.
name: Ukubambwa kwa Yesu Kristo

description: Twumvise amajambo yanditswe na Hezekiya umwami w' Ubuyuda yogushima aho Imana yari imaze kumukura ku mpfiro ikamwongera imyaka 15 y'ukubaho. Hezekiya akora amakosa mu kwereka intumwa zivuye I Babuloni ivyo atunze vyose. Ubuhanuzi bwa Yesaya bwo guhumuriza abantu bavuga ko hazoza umucunguzi wo gukiza ivyaha.
name: Ukuduganwa kw'Ishengero

description: Twabonye ukuntu Imana yaciriye urubanza Yerusalemu ariko yahavuye yigarura yemera gutabara no kuziguriza Yerusalemu natwebwe ab'iki gihe iradukunda kandi yaratwemereye kuturagira n' ukutuzigama kugeza iduhaye ubugingo budashira.
name: Ukugaruka kwa Kristo n'Icizigiro gituma umuntu yezwa

description: Twarumvise ivyo gusenga kw'Ab' Isirayeri ko mu gihe kizoza ishengero rimaze gukurwa mw'isi, bazoba bisabira ko Yesu yogaruka ngo abakure mu makuba.Twarangije tubonye ingene ab'Abisirayeri bicuza ku vyaha bakoze bisabira kubiharirwa.
name: Umubabaro wa Yeremiya

description: Twabanje guheraheza ibijanye n'akamo Imana yateye abantu bayo ngo bahindukire bihane. Ivyo biheze ,twatanguye ikindi ikigabane kini gitanguririra ku gice ca 2 kuza mu ca 5 . Muri ivyo bice, harimwo ubuhanuzi bw' ibihe vya nyuma kandi ko ivyo bihe vya nyuma vyo mw'isezerano rya kera, bitandukanye n'ibihe vya nyuma bivugwa mw'isezerano risha.
name: Umugambi w'Imana wo gucungura abantu bayo

description: Tugize iminsi tuvuga kuvy' umunyamibabaro ariwe Mwami wacu Yesu Kristo nk'uko tubisoma m'ubuhanuzi bw'igitabu c'uwavugishwa n'Imana Yesaya. Twarumvise ivy'imibabaro Kristo yagize ku bwacu gushika aho adupfira k'umusaraba.
name: Umuhamagaro wa Yeremiya

description: Twavuganye ukuntu Imana ishitsa ubuhanuzi bwayo.Yasezeraniye umwami Hezekiya ko izomukingira ngo abasirikare 1150 bari bamwugarije ntibamutere kandi niko vyagenze. Yongera isezerana ko inkumi itazi umugabo izovyara umwana kandi dusoma mw'isezerano risha ko navyo vyashitse.Ivyo bitwereka ko Imana yacu ari Imana ishitsa ubuhanuzi n'amasezerano.
name: Umunezero ukurikirana n'umubabaro

description: Twihweje ivy'ubwiza butangaje bwa Yerusalemu bwo mu gihe c'iherezo . Imana iriteguye gutera iteka ihanga rya Isilayeri kandi igihe Umwami Yesu azoba ariwe ari kungoma kumara imyaka igihumbi amahanga yose azomupfukamira kandi n'abamugararije bazomuhindukirira .
name: Yeremiya arizwa n'ivyaha vy'Abayuda no kuzohanwa kwabo

description: Twaganiriye ku vyaha vy'umurengera Imana yagirije ab'Isirayeri nk'uko twabisomye mu gice ca 59 c'igitabu ca Yesaya .Twarangije twumva ingene Imana yabasezeraniye umucunguzi , uwo ngo niyaza ihanga rya Isirayeri rizokwihana riboroga kubera ubugaba ryagendeyemwo.
name: Yeremiya asaba Isirayeli gutunganya inzira zabo

description: Twumvise ivy'ugutumira kw'Imana kugira ngo abavyipfuza bose bahabwe amazi n'umutsima w'ivy' impwemu. Twarumvise kandi amasezerano y' Imana yo kuremesha abizeye bose bo mu mahanga yose, mu moko yose ,abato n'abakuze .
name: Yosiya atangura gutunganya igihugu
